svg.title: One joint checkpoint instantiates one UnityPSF model for all PSF families
svg.desc: A publication-style architecture figure presenting UnityPSF as a single multimodal PSF foundation model. One joint checkpoint loads one model with a shared input interface, a hard modality-and-channel router, an internal conditional expert layer for 2D emitter, astigmatism, and double-helix PSFs, and one localization output API.
svg.text: One joint checkpoint instantiates one UnityPSF model for all PSF families
UnityPSF frames multimodal PSF localization as one conditional model: shared identity outside, modality-specific physics inside.
One joint checkpoint, one conditional MoE model
single load / single save / single inference entry point

svg.text: checkpoint restores router, experts, channel states, and calibration index
one selected row executes per sample
p, x, y, z, photons + zmap
x, y, z + lobe geometry / LUT
each selected channel owns its trained state
The router and experts are internal modules of UnityPSF; they are not separate user-facing models.
Unity is defined at the release boundary: one checkpoint and one model, with sparse experts inside
router + expert registry + channel states + calibration manifest
one hash / one schema version / one model artifact
conditional parameters are an internal implementation detail
One network handles all supported PSFs
single-channel and dual-channel acquisitions remain configurations of the same model identity
UnityPSF exposes one PSF-general model and checkpoint, while internal MoE routing preserves the physics required by each PSF family.
one checkpoint | one model | all PSFs
